defs.def: a small device that you press or move up and down in order to turn a light or piece of electrical equipment on and off （电路的）开关，闸，转换器

ex.s: The engineers are also trying to develop an on and off＂switch＂where the glow would fade when exposed to daylight.
ex.t: 工程师们还在尝试开发一种开关，使植物在日光照射下光芒变暗。

ex.s: When we turn on a light or switch on a TV or a computer we use energy and we need water to produce this energy.
ex.t: 事实是我们很幸运无论何时想要都有干净的水，但这对于世界上许多人来说并非如此。

ex.s: In Bellevue, the switch to adaptive signals has been a lesson in the value of welcoming new approaches.
ex.t: “它不能解决所有问题，但对较小的城市来说，自适应信号灯有一些好处，”他说。

ex.s: Or maybe you end up switching your attention away from novels, and discover the history of romantic poets in England.
ex.t: 或者你可能最终把注意力从小说上转移开，发现了英国浪漫派诗人的历史。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。

ex.s: The shock of it is like pressing a switch.
ex.t: 那种冲击就像按下一个开关。

ex.s: Intelligent Controls Today, we have to use switches for our lights, knobs for our appliances, and remote controls for our TVs and air conditioners.
ex.t: 今天的智能控制器，我们必须使用开关 开关，开关 开关，开关，开关，开关 电视机和空调机的遥控器。

ex.s: He pulls out a special device, points it at the suspect, and switches it on.
ex.t: 他拿出一件特殊装置，对准嫌疑人，然后打开开关。

defs.def: a change from one thing to another, especially when this is sudden and complete （尤指突然彻底的）改变，转变

ex.s: Perhaps your household won’t entirely make the switch, but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes you desire.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的个人空间有一些控制权来做你想做的改变。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: This switch has decreased   66   (pollute) in the country’s major lakes and reservoirs and made drinking water safer for people.
ex.t: 这一转变减少了该国主要湖泊和水库的____66____（污染），并让人们饮用水更安全。

defs.def: the points on a railway/railroad line （铁路的）转辙器，道岔

ex.s: By using the latest technologies, drones could also start providing higher-value services for railways, detecting faults in the rail or switches, before they can cause any safety problems.
ex.t: 通过使用最新技术，无人机还可以开始为铁路提供更高价值的服务，在铁路或道岔出现故障导致安全问题之前进行检测。

ex.s: They could do precisely the same thing to inspect railway lines and other vital aspects of rail infrastructure such as the correct position of railway tracks and switching points.
ex.t: 检查越频繁，铁路的安全性、可靠性和准点率就会越高。

defs.def: a thin stick that bends easily （细软）枝条；鞭子
to change or make sth change from one thing to another （使）改变，转变，突变

ex.s: Despite them having a mobile phone, it is all too often turned off (“No point in switching it on, when I’m not using it.”), or it can’t be found because it hasn’t been used in weeks (“Now, where did I last see it…?”).
ex.t: 尽管他们有手机，但手机经常关机（"不用的时候开着也没意义。"），或者因为几周没用过而找不到（"嗯，我上次把它放在哪儿了……？"）。

ex.s: Or, have you ever forgotten to switch off the TV or computer?
ex.t: 或者，你有没有忘记关闭电视或电脑？

ex.s: However, in the nottoo-distant future, we will be living in smart homes that will lock the door for us when we are away and remember to switch off the TV when we forget.
ex.t: 然而，在不太遥远的将来，我们将生活在智能家居中，这些家居会在我们外出时为我们锁上门，并在我们忘记时记得关掉电视。

defs.def: to exchange one thing for another 交换；掉换；转换；对调

ex.s: With the detox now finished, they’ve switched on their devices and they’re back online.
ex.t: 他们已经打开他们的设备,

defs.def: to do sb else's job for a short time or work during different hours so that they can do your job or work during your usual hours 调班；临时掉换工作时间

ex.s: Others say we can just “switch them off” as if super intelligent machines are too stupid to think of that possibility.
ex.t: 其他人说，我们可以“把他们甩掉”,仿佛超级智能机器太愚蠢，无法想象这种可能性。
